purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and prompt controls for discovery, preservation, copying, and dangerous delivery of the Ashen Intake's two undelivered notices.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through anchors for ordinary archive work in the Custodian Gallery, the two physical notices, their changing evidence state, the two exits, courier choices, and branch-specific survival or death.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate visual_scene_id anchors for room orientation, routine work, chest opening, seal handling, text revelation, copy selection, route comparison, courier commitment, and each ending family. The empty chest opening and each carrier's arrival, refusal, injury, or death receive distinct replay beats.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Every base prompt describes a complete drawable frame with explicit room geometry, light, material, bodies, tools, routes, and positions. Character refs are assembled only for visible characters. Continuity notes remain tooling constraints.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Hand-painted high-fantasy interactive-fiction illustration, gouache and soot-black ink on textured paper, strong readable silhouettes, dry ochre stone and ash-grey cloth against furnace amber and shutter-pale light, restrained supernatural ambiguity, tactile archive materials, mortal institutional pressure.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble the global_style_cue, one complete scene base_image_prompt, visual refs only for named characters or groups listed as visible in that scene, then triggered state_image_modifiers and global_branch_image_modifiers. Generated images are presentation collateral; the embedded scene_set map owns draft geometry.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: The story reuses one room from several angles and sends carriers through two distinct exits, so the visual plan fixes zones, camera slots, routes, occluders, and evidence anchors for B-level staging.
scene_set_guidance.future_scene_set_need: For high-consistency website art, build a simple plan-view or 3D blockout of the rectangular Custodian Gallery and camera-specific views of the archive crawl, Memorial Sump junction, Eight Screens return, and Cistern House threshold before image generation.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide corner view of a rectangular underground high-fantasy service archive, roughly four paces wide and seven long, built from dry ochre stone under a buried hot-water work. The east wall carries sagging folio shelves, a black calibration chest beneath three octal wheels, a two-arc pressure gauge with two pale shutter marks, and a wall diagram of seven operating baffles around one black shutter. The west wall has a narrow iron return door; the north wall has a low square archive-crawl hatch; the south wall has a heavy service door. Amber oil lamps and a hot ceiling vent cast hard shadows. Sera Venn, a lean young adult custodian in layered grey work robes with an eight-tooth iron spindle at her belt, kneels at the chest. A broad middle-aged priest-engineer in patched dark-red layers, a compact shaved-headed mortuary witness in soot-black clothes with two pale name cloths, and a heat-weary recorder in padded grey-brown delving clothes occupy the open copying floor.

visible_characters.default_stance: kneeling at the octal chest wheels
standing beside the pressure gauge
near the low archive-crawl hatch with two name cloths
seated at the clear floor with pack frame and charcoal

state_image_modifiers.modifier_prompt: The pressure repeater displays exactly two small pale marks on the dark gauge arc.

visual_continuity_notes: The east chest wall, west return door, north crawl hatch, south Crown door, and central copying floor keep fixed relative positions.
The Gallery is dry because of hidden heat, not comfortable or cool.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Close overhead view into an open black calibration chest on the east wall of an underground stone archive. Inside rest a black ceramic comb with six long teeth, one hooked tooth, and one solid edge; a thick stained handoff folio; a pouch of small calibration beads; and two palm-sized folds of ashproof grey service cloth. Each folded notice is sealed with cheap grey wax threaded through a brittle split-reed routing tag. One tag bears a water-witness routing mark and the other a lower-feed mark; both carry a darker later counterseal. Sera Venn's work-scarred fingers hover at the chest edge while Ressa's square hand, Tavi's two pale name cloths, and the recorder's charcoal enter the frame from three separate sides.

visible_characters.default_stance: hands at the chest edge
one hand near the wax folds
name cloths held beside the chest
charcoal poised beside blank cloth

visual_continuity_notes: The notices are small folded service cloths, not books, tablets, scrolls, or magical glowing messages.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide high-fantasy threshold view inside Low Sere's timber-and-stone Cistern House above two settling basins. Warm grey mist beads on heavy beams; water marks, ration boards, sampling bowls, tools, and duplicate warning cloths cover the walls; the drained west basin exposes an iron grate and black pressure door below. Bel Orra, an adult lower-step water witness in a coarse dark wool coat with wet hem and ash-cracked hands, stands at the broad stone basin lip ready to receive a folded notice copy. Maro Seln, a sturdy older cistern reeve in water-stained layered work clothes with a large iron drain key, stands beside the feed wheel. Lower-step residents carry rolled bedding and water vessels behind them.

A violent amber-grey relief pulse fills the one-person passage; two name cloths and the folded copy blow toward the upper hatch while Tavi's body lies below the sump grate, separated from the delivered record.

The surface pressure marks stabilize while Bel receives the notices late; lower-step residents carry full water vessels and wet bedding past an intact but delayed archive copy.

visual_character_refs.purpose: Stable named-character and group visual identities for prompt assembly. Include only refs for bodies visible in a scene.

characters.sera_venn: Sera Venn: lean young adult human intake custodian with medium-brown skin, close-cropped dark hair damp at the temples, narrow tired face, layered ash-grey wool work robes over a leather heat apron, fingerless work gloves, eight-tooth iron spindle at the belt, soot and mineral scale at cuffs, posture economical and watchful.
characters.ressa_orr: Ressa Orr: broad middle-aged human itinerant priest-engineer with weathered umber skin, iron-grey hair in a short wrapped braid, square hands, patched dark-red and charcoal work layers, ceramic eye shields raised on the brow, bronze comparison blade and small lamp, posture deliberate and difficult to hurry.
characters.tavi_kes: Tavi Kes: compact adult human mortuary witness with olive-brown skin, shaved head, soot-black layered coat over practical delving wraps, two pale woven name cloths knotted at the wrist or pack, mineral-ash marks across the fingers, posture quiet and braced around grief.
characters.bel_orra: Bel Orra: adult human lower-step water witness with dark skin, coarse dark wool coat with wet hem, layered work tunic, cracked hands stained by grey ash, one marked sampling cup tied at the waist, posture tired, direct, and forward-leaning with sleeves ready for carrying work.
characters.maro_seln: Maro Seln: sturdy older human cistern reeve with tan weathered skin, cropped grey beard, water-stained brown and blue layered work clothes, heavy apron, large iron drain key and feed-wheel gloves, posture planted beside public machinery and uneasy around disputed paper.

groups.expedition_recorder: Expedition recorder: one adult human working record carrier in practical padded grey-brown clothing, leather knee and forearm guards, compact wooden pack frame, charcoal case, blank and copied ashproof cloth sheets in separate wraps, water flask, plain hood, light protective gear, attentive posture, and physically heat-weary body language.
groups.lower_step_households: Lower-step households: adults and older children in coarse layered wool with wet hems, ash-stained shawls, work aprons, simple boots, and cracked hands, carrying rolled sleeping pallets, blankets, marked water vessels, sample bowls, and small household bundles in an urgent uneven line.
